networks.name: congiuntura_outlook
networks.description: Ask questions about the European economic outlook — press releases from six statistical agencies and the calendar of upcoming releases.
sample_queries: What is the latest signal on euro-area inflation?
Any negative labour-market news from Germany this month?
Which statistical releases are due in the next week?
How is the mood across agencies this month — more positive or negative releases?
What were the previous and forecast values for upcoming euro-area events?
What was Italy's GDP growth in 2019?

peer_policy.note: Open peers: other agentic sites may load and run this network with their visitors' consent and keys (Open Agentic Web Challenge).

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host. The network's data tools live at https://congiuntura.by.gg8.eu/mcp (read-only).
